ShortDescription.Value: A polished, privacy-first Discord activity panel for Cities: Skylines II

Publish.LongDescription:
Show what you are doing in Cities: Skylines II on Discord, with a live activity preview and clear controls for what you share.
WHAT IT DOES
• Shows your current game activity, city, population, date, season, weather, temperature and optional traffic flow. • Lets you adjust the Details and State lines with readable template tokens. • Includes a live preview, connection status, refresh control and callback diagnostics. • Offers Private, Social and Detailed privacy presets plus fine-grained settings. • Can show optional activity from compatible suite tools, then return to your city status. • Can be switched off to hand presence back to the game's vanilla updater.
PRIVACY BY DEFAULT
City-name sharing, treasury and companion activity start off. Population starts rounded. You choose whether to share more. Companion text comes from the other mod that supplies it, so only enable integrations you trust. This mod does not read save paths, account names or your installed mod list for Discord activity.
HOW IT WORKS
Discord RPC uses the Discord Game SDK client already owned by Cities: Skylines II. It does not bundle another Discord SDK, ask for a token, launch a helper process or create a second Discord connection. Discord desktop must be running for activity to appear.
BETA
This is a public beta. The earlier 0.9.2-beta.2 build was loaded in Cities: Skylines II 1.6.2f1 and accepted live activity updates in a disposable city. The 0.9.3-beta.1 visual refresh has build verification but still needs its own in-game visual check. Privacy preset actions and vanilla-presence restoration also need broader in-game verification. Review the displayed activity and choose your sharing settings before using it.

0.9.3-beta.3
• Replaced the hand-drawn Discord-like mark with Discord's official, unmodified symbol.
0.9.3-beta.2
• Reissued the same public-beta presentation as an Unlisted version at the user's request.
0.9.3-beta.1
• Prepared a public beta listing with clearer feature and privacy details. • Reworked the in-game panel hierarchy and Discord-themed visual styling. • Added original, hand-drawn Discord RPC artwork. • Retained the tested shared-client integration and opt-in privacy defaults.
0.9.2-beta.2
• Matched the panel font to CSII's Overpass/Noto Sans UI fonts after in-game inspection. • Fixed in-game panel spacing, unsupported glyph separators, and right-side UI overlap. • Refined panel layout, connection feedback and privacy preset selection. • Companion activity is opt-in on new installs and respects the setting for all activity providers.
0.9.0-beta.1
• Shared-client Discord Game SDK architecture. • Custom presence templates and live preview. • Privacy presets and presence tokens. • Reconnect state and callback diagnostics. • Companion mod activity priority with automatic expiry. • Cooperative vanilla updater restoration.
